gloss: year before an unlucky year; pre-calamity year

definitions.gloss: year before an unlucky year; pre-calamity year
definitions.explanation: The year immediately preceding the main unlucky year (本厄) in the yakudoshi cycle. Considered a warning period when one should begin exercising caution.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}は{前厄|まえやく}だ。
examples.english: Next year is my pre-calamity year.

examples.japanese: {前厄|まえやく}なので{神社|じんじゃ}でお{祓|はら}いをしてもらった。
examples.english: Since it's my pre-calamity year, I had a purification performed at the shrine.

examples.japanese: {前厄|まえやく}から{気|き}をつけ{始|はじ}める{人|ひと}も{多|おお}く、{大|おお}きな{決断|けつだん}を{避|さ}けたり{厄除|やくよ}けのお{守|まも}りを{持|も}ったりする。
examples.english: Many people start being careful from the pre-calamity year, avoiding major decisions and carrying protective charms.

notes:
Part of the {厄年|やくどし} (unlucky year) cycle in Japanese folk belief. The three-year cycle consists of {前厄|まえやく} → {本厄|ほんやく} (main unlucky year) → {後厄|あとやく} (year after). {前厄|まえやく} is the lead-in period, and many people already begin visiting shrines for {厄払|やくばら}い (purification) during this year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前厄|まえやく}に{入|はい}る: to enter the pre-calamity year
- {前厄|まえやく}のお{祓|はら}い: purification for the pre-calamity year
- {前厄|まえやく}から{気|き}をつける: to start being careful from the pre-calamity year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本厄|ほんやく}: main unlucky year — the central and most critical year in the cycle
- {後厄|あとやく}: year after the unlucky year — the final year of the cycle, when misfortune is thought to be fading
- {厄年|やくどし}: unlucky year — the general term for the entire system
- {厄払|やくばら}い: purification ritual — the ceremony performed to ward off bad luck
